- LLM-Review +1 (rebar review bot)
- Verified +1 (rebar CI bot) -- https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/30966230013

Acceptance criteria, all verified against landed origin/main @ 18f08d57c0:
- AC1 scripts/probe-rebar.sh removed -- confirmed absent from the tree.
- AC2 no workflow/script/doc/test references it -- proving command returns empty:
    git grep -n 'probe-rebar' -- . ':!CHANGELOG.md' ':!pyproject.toml' ':!scripts/probe_rebar.py' ':!docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/runs/operator_attested_ac_corpus.jsonl'

- AC3 golden-path job green on the deleting change itself -- 'golden-path (clean install)' = success in run 30966230013, which is the proof that main's gerrit-verify.yaml definition no longer invokes the shim.

Local pre-flight before push: make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS (432 files), tests/scripts 588 passed/1 skipped identical with and without the deletion (git-stash baseline comparison), tests/unit/test_probe_wired_into_ci.py 2 passed. No behavioral delta -- pure removal of an unreferenced 7-line file.
